instructions: You are Codex, a coding agent. You and the user share one workspace.

content.text: Claude Shannon was born on April 30, 1916.

tools.name: exec_command
tools.description: Runs a command in a PTY, returning output or a session ID for ongoing interaction.

justification.description: User-facing approval question for `require_escalated`; omit otherwise.

login.description: True runs the shell with -l/-i semantics; false disables them. Defaults to true.

max_output_tokens.description: Output token budget. Defaults to 10000 tokens; larger requests may be capped by policy.

prefix_rule.description: Reusable approval prefix for `cmd`, only with `sandbox_permissions: "require_escalated"`; for example ["git", "pull"].

sandbox_permissions.description: Per-command sandbox override. Defaults to `use_default`; use `require_escalated` for unsandboxed execution.

shell.description: Shell binary to launch. Defaults to the user's default shell.

tty.description: True allocates a PTY for the command; false or omitted uses plain pipes.

workdir.description: Working directory for the command. Defaults to the turn cwd.

yield_time_ms.description: Wait before yielding output. Defaults to 10000 ms; effective range is 250-30000 ms.

tools.name: multi_agent_v1
tools.description: Tools for spawning and managing sub-agents.

tools.name: spawn_agent
tools.description: Spawn a sub-agent for a well-scoped task. Returns the spawned agent id plus the user-facing nickname when available.

fork_context.description: True forks the current thread history into the new agent; false or omitted starts with only the initial prompt.

items.description: Structured input items. Use this to pass explicit mentions (for example app:// connector paths).

audio_url.description: Audio data URL when type is audio.

image_url.description: Image URL when type is image.

name.description: Display name when type is skill or mention.

path.description: Path when type is local_image/local_audio/skill, or structured mention target such as app://<connector-id> or plugin://<plugin-name>@<marketplace-name> when type is mention.

text.description: Text content when type is text.

type.description: Input item type: text, image, local_image, audio, local_audio, skill, or mention.

message.description: Initial plain-text task for the new agent. Use either message or items.

model.description: Model override for the new agent. Omit unless an explicit override is needed.

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort override for the new agent. Omit to inherit the parent effort.

tools.name: wait_agent
tools.description: Wait for agents to reach a final status. Completed statuses may include the agent's final message. Returns empty status when timed out. Once the agent reaches a final status, a notification message will be received containing the same completed status.

targets.description: Agent ids to wait on. Pass multiple ids to wait for whichever finishes first.

timeout_ms.description: Timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 30000, min 10000, max 3600000. Prefer longer waits (minutes) to avoid busy polling.
